question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing striker, and Eve is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Dave and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) right midfielder
(C) right back
(D) striker
(E) left back
solution:
Player order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: right winger | right midfielder | right back | striker | left back
1. Bob ↔ Dave: right winger | striker | right back | right midfielder | left back
2. Alice ↔ Dave: right midfielder | striker | right back | right winger | left back
3. Dave ↔ Alice: right winger | striker | right back | right midfielder | left back
4. Dave ↔ Alice: right midfielder | striker | right back | right winger | left back
5. Dave ↔ Bob: right midfielder | right winger | right back | striker | left back
Dave is playing striker, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
